text: This is probably nothing and sorry if I'm wasting your time. My stepson (8) has had a temperature since yesterday afternoon, 38.1 just now. While he was getting into his pyjamas I noticed some tiny purplish dots on his arm and chest, like pinpricks. I tried the glass thing and they didn't fade at all. He says they don't hurt. Not sure if that's something or if I'm overreacting?
